tiers.name: Recruiting Dealer II
tiers.description:
One Bulwark, one Waller, and one Lentigo all with code Water P.S.I.D. will spawn.
They will first appear 3 seconds after the battle begins and then reappear every 40 seconds.
Bulwarks set up a shield in the front to block attacks.
Wallers apply a buff that increases the Raptures' DEF.
Lentigos apply a buff that decreases the Nikkes' ATK.
The Waller and Lentigo that appear due to this option are immune to all damage except from their counter-code.

tiers.name: Stun Gun I
tiers.description:
Five Oculuses with code Water P.S.I.D. will spawn.
They will first appear 10 seconds after the battle begins and then reappear every 20 seconds.
Oculuses can stun Nikkes with their attacks.

tiers.name: Stun Gun II
tiers.description:
Five Oculuses with code Water P.S.I.D. will spawn.
They will first appear 10 seconds after the battle begins and then reappear every 20 seconds.
Oculuses can stun Nikkes with their attacks.
The Oculuses that appear due to this option are immune to all damage except from their counter-code.

tiers.name: Whale Hunting
tiers.description:
Mother Whale with code Water P.S.I.D. will appear.
It will spawn Cancel Rings and deal massive damage to all Nikkes if the rings are not destroyed.
Mother Whale's attacks pierce cover.

tiers.name: Relevant Personnel Only
tiers.description:
A high-difficulty battle will appear right before the BOSS stage instead of option selection.
Increases the chance of advanced buff(s) appearing when clearing this difficult battle.

tiers.name: Prepare for Simulation
tiers.description:
Nikkes at level 400 or above will have their level fixed at 400.
This option cannot be changed.

tiers.name: Enemy Weapon Up I
tiers.description: At the start of battle, Raptures' ATK is increased by 15%.

tiers.name: Enemy Weapon Up II
tiers.description: At the start of battle, Raptures' ATK is increased by 20%.

tiers.name: Enemy Weapon Up III
tiers.description: At the start of battle, Raptures' ATK is increased by 25%.

tiers.name: Enemy Weapon Up IV
tiers.description: At the start of battle, Raptures' ATK is increased by 30%.

tiers.name: Enemy Armor Up I
tiers.description: At the start of battle, Raptures' DEF is increased by 10%.

tiers.name: Enemy Armor Up II
tiers.description: At the start of battle, Raptures' DEF is increased by 30%.

tiers.name: Enemy Armor Up III
tiers.description: At the start of battle, Raptures' DEF is increased by 50%.

tiers.name: Enemy Armor Up IV

tiers.name: Enemy Vitals Up I
tiers.description: At the start of battle, Raptures' max HP is increased by 20%.

tiers.name: Enemy Vitals Up II
tiers.description: At the start of battle, Raptures' max HP is increased by 25%.

tiers.name: Enemy Vitals Up III
tiers.description: At the start of battle, Raptures' max HP is increased by 30%.

tiers.name: Enemy Vitals Up IV

tiers.name: Memory Loss
tiers.description: Stat bonuses from Nikke Bond levels are disabled.

tiers.name: No Recycling
tiers.description: Stat bonuses from the Recycling Room are disabled.

tiers.name: Aggressive Tactics
tiers.description:
Normal difficulty no longer appears for battle stages.
Choices other than battle stages have a reduced chance of appearing.

tiers.name: Rush Hour I
tiers.description: The duration of Destroy is reduced by 10%.

tiers.name: Rush Hour II
tiers.description: The duration of Destroy is reduced by 20%.

tiers.name: Rush Hour III
tiers.description: The duration of Destroy is reduced by 30%.

tiers.name: Vacation Order I
tiers.description:
Cannot add Burst I Nikkes who use submachine guns to the squad.
They are not eligible for Simulation Room effects.

tiers.name: Stopwatch: Burst I
tiers.description: The cooldown of Burst I Nikkes' Burst Skills is fixed at 40 seconds and is not affected by effects that reduce Burst Skill cooldown time.

tiers.name: Vacation Order II
tiers.description:
Cannot add Burst II Nikkes who use assault rifles to the squad.
They are not eligible for Simulation Room effects.

tiers.name: Stopwatch: Burst II
tiers.description: The cooldown of Burst II Nikkes' Burst Skills is fixed at 40 seconds and is not affected by effects that reduce Burst Skill cooldown time.

tiers.name: Code Fix I
tiers.description: All Rapture codes will be fixed as Iron D.M.T.R.

tiers.name: Code Fix II
tiers.description:
All Rapture codes will be fixed as Iron D.M.T.R.
The target Rapture will only take damage from its counter-code.

tiers.name: Hug Me I
tiers.description:
Four Remnants with code Iron D.M.T.R. will appear every 20 seconds.
Remnants self-destruct after they spawn.

tiers.name: Hug Me II
tiers.description:
Four Remnants with code Iron D.M.T.R. will appear every 20 seconds.
Remnants self-destruct after they spawn.
The Remnants that appear due to this option are immune to all damage except from their counter-code.

tiers.name: Twinkle Twinkle I
tiers.description:
One Exceed Ponytail with code Iron D.M.T.R. will appear every 20 seconds.
Ponytails restore all Raptures' HP.

tiers.name: Twinkle Twinkle II
tiers.description:
One Exceed Ponytail with code Iron D.M.T.R. will appear every 20 seconds.
Ponytails restore all Raptures' HP.
The Ponytail that appears due to this option is immune to all damage except from its counter-code.
